headline: 影剧热榜：新片新剧齐发
summary: 本周电影市场由《野马九号》《小丑回魂：德里故事》等热作带动；剧集方面，《再婚皇后》首播，《侠探杰克》《梦魇绝镇》持续热播，待播《银翼杀手2099》受关注。

industryHighlights.text: 本周电影热作包括《野马九号》《戴帽子的猫》《小丑回魂：德里故事》等。
industryHighlights.en: This week's movie highlights include Wild Horse No. 9, The Cat in the Hat, and It: Derry Story.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《再婚皇后》本周首播，《侠探杰克》《梦魇绝镇》等持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: New series The Remarried Empress premieres this week, while Reacher and From remain popular.

industryHighlights.text: 待播剧《银翼杀手2099》受关注，待映片单含《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming series Blade Runner 2099 draws attention; upcoming films include Avengers 5 and Dune 3.

headlineEn: Film & TV Buzz: New Releases Lead
summaryEn: This week's film slate is led by Wild Horse No. 9 and It: Derry Story; on TV, The Remarried Empress premieres while Reacher and From stay hot, with Blade Runner 2099 upcoming.
